paper.citation: Ding, P., VanderWeele, T. J. and Robins, J. M. (2017). Instrumental variables as bias amplifiers with general outcome and confounding. Biometrika 104(2), 291–302. DOI: 10.1093/biomet/asx009.
paper.source_locator: arXiv:1701.04177v1 (2017-01-16), §5.1 PDF p.8 and Table 1 p.9, Cases 1–3; causal graph Fig.1(b) p.2 and causal framework §2 pp.3–4. PDF page numbers refer to this fixed preprint, not journal pagination.

mechanism.name: IV：二元混杂、偏差放大与局部平均处理效应
generation_equations: Z ~ Bernoulli(0.5), U ~ Bernoulli(0.5), V_A,V_Y iid Uniform(0,1); all four independent.
p[z,u]=P(A=1|Z=z,U=u), r[a,u]=P(Y=1|A=a,U=u); fixed values from source Table 1.
Source population ATE=sum_u q[u]*tau[u]; it is an audit quantity, not the registered IV target.

sampling.dependence: iid across individuals; within-unit dependence through latent U and the declared SCM

assumptions: Consistency and no interference; iid individuals.
Randomized binary Z independent of U and all exogenous thresholds; 0<P(Z=1)<1.
Exclusion: Y(a,z)=Y(a), so Z affects Y only through A.
Treatment monotonicity A(1)>=A(0) under the declared shared-threshold coupling.
Nonzero first stage P(A(1)>A(0))>0 in each source scenario.
The chosen SCM has independent treatment/outcome thresholds given U; U is unobserved.
These IV conditions identify LATE, not the overall ATE without further restrictions.

properties.notes: 无观察基线协变量，dimension=effective_dimension=0；1个工具 Z、1个隐藏混杂 U。三场景分别含 Z*U 概率交互系数 0.1,-0.1,-0.2，以及 A*U 系数 0.01,-0.01,-0.03。nonlinear=true 指双线性交互与二元阈值函数；不是 logistic 模型，也不声称高维。

estimand.name: LATE
estimand.definition: E[Y(1)-Y(0) | A(1)>A(0)], treatment intervention 0 to 1 among instrument compliers.

truth.expression: E[Y(1)-Y(0) | A(1)>A(0)], treatment intervention 0 to 1 among instrument compliers.
truth.derivation: 独立 Z 与排除限制使 ΔY=Σq_u(p_1u−p_0u)(r_1u−r_0u)，ΔA=Σq_u(p_1u−p_0u)。共享处理阈值给出无 defier，故 ΔA 为 complier 比例，Wald 比值 ΔY/ΔA 等于 LATE。Case 1/2/3 的精确分数分别为 61/1100、1/100、9/400。

adaptations: 原文 Table 1 是偏差放大问题的总体数值例子；本包保留其三组观察分布参数，但将登记目标由原文 ATE 改为 LATE。
补充独立阈值 SCM：Z、U、V_A、V_Y 相互独立；同一 V_A 用于 A(0),A(1)，同一 V_Y 用于 Y(0),Y(1)。原文未指定这种跨干预耦合。
p[1,u]>=p[0,u] 与共享 V_A 保证个体单调性；仅有源概率的均值单调性本身不足以推出个体单调性。
该 SCM 精确匹配所选条件概率；共享结果阈值是兼容实现的选择，并非声称恢复作者未指定的完整潜在结果联合分布。
独立编写 Python/NumPy PCG64 生成器；n=128、seed=1729 是学生包检查设置，不是论文报告的实验设置或精度保证。
仅导出 Z,A,Y；U、阈值噪声、潜在结果和个体效应留在机制定义中，不作为估计器特征。
